verdict.rationale: The evidence covers account opening, KYC, statements, authorized users and payment rails. None of it documents whether funds are held in FBO pooled accounts or individual accounts, where FDIC insurance attaches, or who can see the ledger. This transparency axis applies to a banking-as-a-service platform, so the lack of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the account structure is transparent — whether funds sit in FBO pools or individual accounts, where FDIC insurance actually attaches, and who can see the ledger, all documented plainly
